lead: `null as ?string` is `""`, not `null`, so it cannot tell a missing query parameter from an empty one.
body: `rule:expressions/nullable-conversion` makes `as ?string` render exactly what `as string` renders, and `null` renders `""`; `null as ?int` is `null`, so the two read alike and behave differently. `Core\Request::query(...)` already answers `?tainted string`: compare it to `null` or write `?? ""`, and never `as string` or `as ?string` on it.
